info.p: Columns of unequal width balanced before a span="all" block (CR-026 phase B). Helvetica 10pt on a 12pt line, a letter page with a 720pt body, paragraphs of sixty words with 6pt after each. Five page-sequences: (1) two columns of 125.45pt and 360.8pt, nine paragraphs then a heading across all columns: the columns are balanced at 33 and 31 lines and the heading follows on page 1; unbalanced, the first column held 58 lines, the second 21, and the heading opened page 2 behind an empty span, as Apache FOP lays it with balancing disabled. (2) three columns of 81.25, 58.25 and 358pt: 33, 33 and 31 lines, the heading on the page. (3) the heading with fox:disable-column-balancing="true": Apache FOP's own output, 58 and 21 lines, the heading on the next page. (4) thirty paragraphs then the heading: the heading falls on the second page, whose first column is a list read again from inside a paragraph (the restart replayed on the trial's own managers); the second page is balanced at 49 and 47 lines. (5) four paragraphs then the heading: the list fits the first column alone; balanced at 14 and 13 lines.
